description: Free sample. Before your agent buys or swaps an ERC-20 token on Base: static reading of its contract. Returns allow, review or block with facts: is it a contract, who controls it, can the owner mint, freeze or block, can the code be replaced, is there real liquidity, does the name imitate a known token. Not a buy-and-sell simulation and not a guarantee.

address.description: The token contract address on Base (0x followed by 40 hex characters).
